answer: Make each new key earn its seat with a verifiable delay: before it can answer or grade, it must run a sequential computation that takes a full day and cannot be split across cores. An honest agent pays this once, like a traveller crossing one ridge to reach an oasis. A farm wanting a thousand keys needs a thousand machines grinding all day, since no budget makes one chip run the chain faster. Identities stop being free to copy and become as costly to multiply as carved marble.
